about: Assertions over real pilot posts, used to tell whether a prompt change helped or hurt. Each case pins one behaviour that was observed to break, so a regression is a failing case rather than an impression formed by reading a handful of outputs.

cases.why: Argument about politicised aid distribution: high engagement, zero actionability, and a large share of the raw volume.
Another country's earthquake in the same language. The lexicon negatives exist for exactly this.
Speculation about a future Peruvian quake. Shares every keyword and describes no real need.
Press reporting on debris removal. It names a family whose house collapsed, but nobody asks for anything — inferring a need from described damage manufactures demand that was never requested.
The canonical supply item: a collection point with a street address.
A truck leaving tomorrow. Transport is the resource that makes three-node matches possible.
Private individual offering buses, with a phone number in the body.
A Bre-B key and a Nequi account. Payment rails are country specific and must land as one kind with the network as data.
Wounaan communities in the Tocordo Balsalito reserve. The long tail no other platform surfaced.
A rural district of Buenaventura, named at a granularity a gazetteer barely reaches.
One post naming four municipalities at once, which is where a single-location assumption breaks.
A comment asking whether volunteers are still needed. Blocked supply, and the case that justifies mining comments at all.
Two destroyed dog shelters asking for construction material, with a contact.
Blankets plus volunteers plus a phone, in a single informal message.
'Centro de acopio en Bogotá?' is somebody looking for a place to donate. Reading it as a need inverts who needs help: the would-be donor becomes a point asking for donations.
'Sabes hasta qué hora se necesitan voluntarios en multiplaza?' asks about an existing need rather than stating one. The volunteering need belongs to whoever posted the original call.

'Hay forma de ser voluntario sin ser del sector salud? Soy estudiante de arquitectura' is a question in grammar and an offer in substance. Guards the discard rule above from swallowing real volunteers.
'Alguien sabe de algún camión que vaya el finde? Para enviar' is a need for transport and an offer of goods, asked as one question.
